item.title: New human data hints at psychedelics' potential to combat inflammation
item.description: Lab studies have shown that psychedelics like psilocybin can lower inflammation and may be protective for a range of illnesses. Now, researchers are publishing some of the first data in humans that signals this holds potential for patients with neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson's disease.

item.title: How much does pregnancy cost? Be prepared with these tips
item.description: The cost of having a baby is difficult to predict. The amount families pay varies widely. Here are five tips to help you prepare for the often unexpected costs of pregnancy and giving birth.

item.title: Actor Christina Applegate says she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis
item.description: Actor Christina Applegate revealed she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis. NPR's A Martínez speaks with neurologist Michael Kornberg about how MS can be misdiagnosed.

item.title: Influencers are helping 'free birth' gain fans, despite medical risks
item.description: The practice known as "free birth" — giving birth at home without a midwife — carries severe risks. But social media influencers are bringing attention and followers to the practice.

item.title: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case in Abuja as a woman arriving from Uganda tests positive
item.description: Nigeria is the latest country to report an Ebola case as the outbreak spreads across the region. Kenya confirmed its first case earlier this month and has since recorded nine infections.

item.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
item.description: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.
